what: Restoring a backup taken before a reset is wiped by the next Drive sync. The backup carries its old epoch (0); Drive holds the post-reset epoch (1), so pullOrPush sees er>ea and adopts the empty Drive copy ('Progress was reset on another device; applied'). Restoring after an accidental reset, the main reason to restore, silently undoes itself within 8 s.
evidence: t25/sabotage.py S3b: seed xp 100, copy backup, connect, Reset x2, sync, Restore the backup -> S=[epoch 0, xp 100]; syncAll(true) -> [epoch 1, xp 0, 'Progress was reset on another device; applied'].
fix: In bkApply set the restored state's epoch to Math.max(+S.epoch||0,+st.epoch||0) (the current epoch, never lower) before S=migrate(st), then call syncAll(true) so it merges with Drive. Optionally offer 'Replace on all devices' which uses current epoch+1.

what: Reset says 'Erases lessons, stats, XP and mistakes on this device. Settings stay.' but with Drive connected it bumps epoch and wipes every synced phone and the Drive copy, and it also erases the real gas log (gaslog is not in keep{} and is not mentioned).
evidence: S3: phone B Reset; phone A syncs -> A shows epoch 1, xp 0, done [], logList().length 0 (A had 4 logged gases). Row text read from the page: 'Erases lessons, stats, XP and mistakes on this device. Settings stay.'
fix: Change the copy when signedIn(): 'Erases progress on this device, on your Drive and on your other devices, including the gas log.' Add a choice: 'Reset this device only' (keep epoch, just clear locally and re-pull? or simply sign out first) vs 'Reset everywhere'. Keep S.gaslog in keep{} unless the user ticks 'also delete my gas log'.

where: Gas interpreter · Paste a printout → Read values ($("pGo").onclick, line 15)
what: 'Read values' resets the sample to arterial unless the pasted text itself says venous: IV=Object.assign({sample:r.ven?'v':'a'},…). The Venous toggle I set first is silently lost. The VBG is then read as an ABG. Winter's runs on the venous PCO₂ and the read is a false 'NAGMA + respiratory acidosis'. The headline line starts 'ABG:'. That line is what gets copied to the notes.
evidence: Phone 390×844: Clear → tap Venous → paste 'pH 7.29 pCO2 40 HCO3 19 Na 138 K 3.2 Cl 110 Lac 1.6 Glu 6.1' → Read values. IV.sample === 'a'. Read: 'NAGMA + respiratory acidosis' with 'expected 35–39, measured 40'. Tapping Venous again gives the correct 'NAGMA with appropriate respiratory compensation' on the estimated arterial PCO₂ of 35. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T30-phone-vbg-after-read.png
fix: Keep the current IV.sample unless parseGas finds an explicit sample word: sample: r.ven ? 'v' : (r.art ? 'a' : IV.sample). Show the sample in the toast ('Read 8 values · venous'). Also put a visible 'Arterial / Venous?' prompt next to Read values.

what: Reset progress also erases the live gas log (S.gaslog: real gases the user typed on shift, with tags and notes), the case library progress (S.cases), badges, flash-card state, teach, qmiss (the source of 'Send missed points to Yuzu') and S.ui. The row text only says 'Erases lessons, stats, XP and mistakes… Settings stay.' The gas log is user-entered clinical work, not progress, and there is no undo.
evidence: Seed S.gaslog=[{…note:'bed 4'}], S.cases, S.badges, then tap Reset twice: changed keys = done, kinds, days, dayN, mist, ui, xp, teach, badges, flash, gaslog, cases, qmiss, round, savedAt, epoch. localStorage holds only buffer.v1 afterwards, so there is no backup copy.
fix: Keep gaslog (and ideally ui) in the `keep` object, or offer two separate actions: 'Reset learning progress' and 'Delete gas log'. List exactly what goes in the row text. Before erasing, save the old state to localStorage 'buffer.v1.undo' and show a toast 'Progress reset · Undo' for 10 s.

what: Restore overwrites all progress at once, with no confirmation, and accepts almost any object. The only check is that `kinds` or `done` exists, so pasting '{"done":5}' (or a stray settings fragment) wipes a full profile and reports 'Restored.' Nothing is kept to undo it.
evidence: With a rich profile (3 lessons, 900 XP, a gas log, kPa, light, clinical), paste {"done":5} and press Restore: the message is 'Restored.', and S becomes the defaults (mmHg, dark, pixel, 0 lessons).
fix: Before applying, parse the backup and show a summary such as 'Backup from 12/11/2026: 37 lessons, 412 gases, 6 log entries. Replace what is on this device?' with Replace and Cancel. Require buffer_backup:1 (or at least v and a few keys of the right type). Keep the previous state in localStorage 'buffer.v1.undo' and offer Undo.

what: The lesson pack exports all 490 check questions as type 'basic', with only the stem on the front and none of the options. At least 63 stems depend on their options ('Which practice schedule…', 'Changes PaCO₂ from 40 to about…'), which makes them unanswerable as recall cards. Meanwhile 'Send missed points to Yuzu' (ui9.js yuzuMissCards) exports the same questions as type 'mcq' with options, under a different id scheme ('buf-q-<lid>-<qi>' vs 'buffer-<lid>-q<i>'). Importing both puts duplicate cards in Yuzu.
evidence: Export the lesson pack (via the textarea fallback): 806 cards = 490 basic + 316 cloze, 0 mcq. A regex for stems that start with 'Which' or end in '…' finds 63. Compare ui9.js:29 ids 'buf-q-'+lid+'-'+qi.
fix: Export lesson questions as {type:'mcq', question, options:[{text,correct}], explanation, source} as yuzuMissCards does, and use one shared id function (e.g. 'buffer-'+lid+'-q'+i) in both places so Yuzu merges them.

where: kPa mode, formulas card and errors
what: With Settings set to kPa, the Formulas card still shows only mmHg ranges, and validation errors give mmHg limits ('PCO₂ 3.2 is outside … 5–200 mmHg') for a value the user typed in kPa.
evidence: S.units='kPa'; FORMULAS() is static text; validate() reports in mmHg.
fix: Render the PCO2 and PO2 thresholds in FORMULAS with P() and PU(). In runInterp, convert the reported value in o.err back to kPa (or validate before conversion).

what: #pTxt has no label or aria-label (the h3 'Paste a printout' is not associated). The example select has an aria-label, but nothing shows which example is loaded after selection, because it resets to 'Load an example…'.
evidence: $('pTxt').getAttribute('aria-label') === null.
fix: Add aria-labelledby on the textarea. After loading, show a small chip 'Example: Salicylate' (cleared when the user edits).

what: The practice-gas pack can contain duplicate card ids, because the id is kind+pH+PCO₂+HCO₃⁻ and genCase can repeat a gas. A duplicate in one pack can overwrite or reject a card on import.
evidence: Over 20 packs of 30 there was 1 duplicate in 600 cards. Real example: 'buffer-gas-ralk_a-753-27-219' appeared twice in one pack (gases.json).
fix: Skip a card whose id is already in the pack (keep generating until n unique), or add the index ('…-'+cards.length).

what: 'Practice gases are … weighted to the patterns you miss', but ks takes the first 8 kinds after sorting, and untried kinds count as 0.6. A new user (or anyone who has not met the mixed kinds) therefore gets only the 8 simple disorders (hagma, nagma, malk, rac_a/c/ac, ralk_a/c) and never the 7 mixed disorders, which are the hardest reads.
evidence: With fresh state, gases.json kinds = {hagma:4, nagma:4, malk:4, rac_a:4, rac_c:4, rac_ac:4, ralk_a:3, ralk_c:3}. KINDS has 15.
fix: Weight all 15 kinds, e.g. probability ∝ (1 − accuracy) + 0.2, with untried kinds at 0.5, so mixed disorders always appear. Also respect S.lvl rather than a fixed level 4.

what: The Yuzu note promises 'ids are stable', but lesson card ids are positional ('buffer-<lesson>-q<index>', with XQ questions appended after the base ones). Adding or removing one base question in a lesson shifts every later index, so re-importing attaches old review history to different questions. The same applies to S.qmiss keys 'lid:qi'.
evidence: See cardsFromLessons() and c9.js (XQ pushed after L.q).
fix: Give each question a short content hash (e.g. FNV of the stem) and use it in card ids and qmiss keys, or add explicit ids to questions.

what: The anion gap reference field accepts decimals (10.5 is saved) and silently ignores out-of-range input: typing 3 or 17 leaves the field showing 3/17 while the app keeps the old value, with no message. A blank field also keeps the old value without saying so.
evidence: Fill #sAg with '3' → S.agref stays 12 while the box shows 3. Fill '10.5' → S.agref=10.5.
fix: On change (not oninput), round to an integer, clamp to 4–16, write the clamped value back into the field, and toast 'Anion gap reference: 10'. Show a red outline if the input is invalid.

what: The altitude select can only show three values. A restored or synced patm that is not 760, 707 or 580 shows as 'Sea level (760 mmHg)' while the engine uses the real value. The option labels stay in mmHg in kPa mode, and the toast 'Altitude updated' does not say what it changed to.
evidence: Restore with patm 700: Settings shows 'Sea level'.
fix: Add a 'Custom…' option that reveals a number input (barometric pressure, or elevation in metres converted with the barometric formula). Show labels in S.units. Toast 'Altitude: Riyadh, 707 mmHg'.

what: In Auto theme, when the device switches between light and dark, applyTheme() swaps the CSS tokens but canvases already drawn (Davenport, maps, ODC, interpreter map) keep the old palette: dark label boxes and dark dashed lines on a cream background, and white dots that vanish.
evidence: Open m-dav with OS dark and theme Auto, then emulate prefers-color-scheme: light: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-auto-switch-dav.png (dark box behind '7.40', near-invisible white points).
fix: In the matchMedia change handler, after applyTheme(), re-render the current view (safe(()=>RENDER[VIEW]()) for non-session views, or call each model's redraw). The same is needed if the theme ever changes without a re-render.

what: Unverified links. The NPS PDF link (nps.org.au/assets/AP/pdf/…) is the legacy Australian Prescriber host. The journal has moved to australianprescriber.tg.org.au (the same article is indexed there), and the old asset URL may redirect or break in future. The LITFL entry points at the homepage and asks the user to search. I could not open any link from this sandbox (proxy 403), so I confirmed only that search engines index all four URLs.
evidence: WebSearch shows both https://www.nps.org.au/assets/AP/pdf/The-interpretation-of-arterial-blood-gases.pdf and https://australianprescriber.tg.org.au/articles/the-interpretation-of-arterial-blood-gases.html. The ATS and UW URLs are also indexed.
fix: Point NPS at the australianprescriber.tg.org.au article page and LITFL at its acid–base library page. Add a 'checked dd/mm/yyyy' note and a quick check of the links at release.

what: The Quiet mode checkbox is a bare 13×13 px native checkbox, not wrapped in its label row. It is the smallest target in the app, and clicking the "Quiet mode" text does not toggle it.
evidence: audit: input#sQuiet 13x13.
fix: Wrap the .srow in a <label for="sQuiet">, or style the checkbox as a 44 px switch (role="switch" aria-checked).

what: The pack metadata is stale: source:'Buffer Blood Gas Trainer, Oct 2026' is fixed text with no app version, while the app is 4.9.0 from Nov 2026.
evidence: Every exported pack has 'source': 'Buffer Blood Gas Trainer, Oct 2026'.
fix: Use source:'Buffer '+APP_VERSION+' · exported '+ddmmyyyy().

what: 'Cases per session' has an empty description, and the naming is inconsistent: Settings says 'cases', Practice says 'GASES PER SESSION', and Settings 'Daily goal' says 'gases'.
evidence: Settings shows 'Cases per session' with no sub-line. Practice shows 'GASES PER SESSION 5/10/20'.
fix: Rename it 'Gases per session' with the sub-line 'Length of Mixed, Step-by-step and Quick read sessions. Reflex and boss rounds have their own length.'

what: The section eyebrow 'LOOK' repeats the row title 'Look' directly beneath it, and Quiet mode (a behaviour setting) sits under 'Look'.
evidence: See /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-settings-desk-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Call the eyebrow 'Appearance' and the row 'Skin', and move Quiet mode to the Practice card (or a 'Feel' card).

what: When the clipboard is blocked, the backup text is put into the box labelled 'Paste a Buffer backup here', right above the Restore button. It looks like an import box, and pressing Restore re-applies the same data.
evidence: In headless Chromium (clipboard denied), pressing Copy backup opens #bkIn with the backup text in it.
fix: Use a separate read-only textarea (as the Yuzu card does, #yzTa) with a 'Select all' button, and keep the restore box empty.

what: The 'Lesson pack (806)' button has the copy icon but '30 practice gases' does not. The labels also do not say that they copy.
evidence: See /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T24-settings-desk-pixel-dark.png.
fix: Give both buttons ic('copy') and the labels 'Copy lesson pack (806 cards)' and 'Copy 30 practice gases'.

what: Some settings give no feedback (anion gap, K⁺, hints, goal, session length save silently) while units and altitude toast. Nothing tells the user that open tools re-read the values.
evidence: Change each control and watch #toasts.
fix: Toast every change consistently ('Daily goal: 20 gases'), or show a small 'Saved' tick beside the row.

what: Allow a custom barometric pressure (or an altitude in metres converted with the standard atmosphere), so sp-alt's advice to set your city works for any place, e.g. Taif ≈ 1,880 m or Denver.
evidence: ui3.js:155 offers three presets only
fix: Add an 'Other…' option with a number input (mmHg) or a metres field: Pb = 760 × (1 − 2.25577e−5 × h)^5.2559.

what: Add 'Save backup file' and 'Open backup file' buttons (a Blob download as buffer-backup-dd-mm-yyyy.json, and <input type=file>). Do the same for the Yuzu packs ('Download .yuzu.json'). The user works on a Steam Deck and a Samsung tablet, where pasting 229 KB into a new file is painful, and the clipboard is blocked in some contexts.
evidence: The lesson pack is 229 KB (806 cards). The message tells the user to paste it into a file named buffer-core.yuzu.json themselves.
fix: const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([txt],{type:'application/json'}));a.download=name;a.click(); and use navigator.share({files}) where available.

what: Take an automatic snapshot before any destructive action (reset, restore, Drive merge) and offer 'Undo' for 10 s plus a 'Restore previous state' link in Your data.
fix: Keep a single localStorage 'buffer.v1.prev' with a timestamp, and show 'Previous state from dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm · Restore' when one exists.

what: Add a custom barometric pressure or elevation entry. Qiddiya and other sites the user covers are neither sea level nor exactly Riyadh, and the A–a sums depend on it.
evidence: The current options are only 760, 707 and 580.
fix: Number input in mmHg/kPa, or elevation in metres → P = 760·(1 − 2.25577e-5·h)^5.2559. That gives 707 at 610 m and 577 at 2,270 m, which matches the presets.

what: Add a 'US lab units' option (glucose mg/dL, urea/BUN mg/dL, albumin g/dL, creatinine mg/dL) for USMLE Step 1/2 practice. At the moment only pressure units switch.
evidence: The user prepares for both MRCEM (SI/kPa) and USMLE (mmHg and conventional units).
fix: Add S.labUnits ('SI'|'US') with converters next to P()/PU() (e.g. G() for glucose ×18), and apply them in slip(), the interpreter fields and case text.

what: Make the version line useful: 'Buffer 4.9.0 · built dd/mm/yyyy' with a 'What's new' link and a 'Copy diagnostics' button (version, skin, theme, units, characterSet, display-mode, storage size) for bug reports.
evidence: At the moment it is only the eyebrow 'BUFFER 4.9.0'.
fix: Add BUILD_DATE in build.py and render it together with a diagnostics JSON copy.

what: Add UK and exam-relevant free sources: the BTS emergency oxygen guideline (target saturations), RCEM learning (ABG modules), and the Australian Prescriber article's new home. Also say plainly that the links need a connection, since the app is offline-first.
evidence: The list has 4 entries, none of them UK or MRCEM-specific.
fix: Extend RES with 2–3 entries and a 'needs internet' note.

what: Show a live mini slip under 'Reading gases' (e.g. 'PaCO₂ 5.3 kPa · AG ref 12 (16 with K⁺) · PAO₂ on air ≈ 100 mmHg at this altitude'), so the effect of each setting is visible at once.
fix: Render a small .slip using P()/PU() and the alveolar equation, and re-render it on each change.

what: Bring the accessibility options together in one place, so users do not depend on OS settings or the hold gestures.
evidence: None; this is an improvement.
fix: Add a Settings group with: Extended time (×2, ×3 or untimed) for Five-second read, Pattern flash, Reflex, Boss and Final; Reduce motion in the app, overriding RM() (the OS setting is already honoured: rAF counts were 0 under reduce for every model); Larger text (scales the 9–10 px labels to 13 px); Colour-blind-safe answers (✓/✗ and hatching everywhere); and a "Keyboard shortcuts" help list.
